name: NKBesicovitch.inner_normalCoordinatesWithBasis
statement:
theorem inner_normalCoordinatesWithBasis {m : ℕ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
    (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (t s : ℝ) :
    ⟪normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t), normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (y, s)⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ + t * s

name: NKBesicovitch.lipschitz_normalCoordinatesWithBasis_symm_fst

theorem lipschitz_normalCoordinatesWithBasis_symm_fst {m : ℕ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun z ↦ ((normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b).symm z).1)

statement:
theorem measurePreserving_normalCoordinates (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) :

name: NKBesicovitch.measurePreserving_normalCoordinatesWithBasis
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_normalCoordinatesWithBasis {m : ℕ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)

name: NKBesicovitch.norm_normalCoordinatesWithBasis_symm_fst_le

name: NKBesicovitch.norm_normalCoordinates_sq
statement:
theorem norm_normalCoordinates_sq (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖normalCoordinates hv (x, t)‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 + t ^ 2

name: NKBesicovitch.normalCoordinatesWithBasis_apply
statement:
theorem normalCoordinatesWithBasis_apply {m : ℕ} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (t : ℝ) :
    normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t) = (b x : E) + t • v

name: NKBesicovitch.normalCoordinates_apply

theorem normalCoordinates_apply (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (t : ℝ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.normalCoordinates_symm_fst
statement:
theorem normalCoordinates_symm_fst (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (y : E) :

name: NKBesicovitch.normalCoordinates_symm_snd
statement:
theorem normalCoordinates_symm_snd (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (y : E) :

name: NKBesicovitch.slope_normalDirection
statement:
theorem slope_normalDirection (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (ξ : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_finite_bounded_slope_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_bounded_slope_cover [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ s : Finset (sphere (0 : E) 1), ∀ w : sphere (0 : E) 1,
      ∃ v ∈ s, ∃ ξ : (ℝ ∙ (v : E))ᗮ,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ ⟪(v : E), (normalDirection (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v) ξ : E)⟫_ℝ ∧
          normalDirection (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v) ξ = w

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_finite_normal_cap_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_normal_cap_cover [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ s : Finset (sphere (0 : E) 1), ∀ w : sphere (0 : E) 1,

name: NKBesicovitch.measurableSet_normalSlopes
NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_toSphere_normalDirection_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_toSphere_normalDirection_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {A : Set (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm f p ((volume : Measure E).toSphere.restrict (normalDirection hv '' A)) ≤
      (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / p.toReal) *
        eLpNorm (f ∘ normalDirection hv) p (volume.restrict A)

name: NKBesicovitch.measurableSet_slopeCone
statement:
theorem measurableSet_slopeCone (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    MeasurableSet {z : H × ℝ | z.2 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ z.2⁻¹ • z.1 ∈ A}

name: NKBesicovitch.normalDirection_cone_subset
statement:
theorem normalDirection_cone_subset (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (A : Set (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' (normalDirection hv '' A)) ⊆
      normalCoordinates hv ''
        {z : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ × ℝ | z.2 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ z.2⁻¹ • z.1 ∈ A}

name: NKBesicovitch.toSphere_normalDirection_image_le
statement:
theorem toSphere_normalDirection_image_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {A : Set (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (volume : Measure E).toSphere (normalDirection hv '' A) ≤
      (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ≥0∞) * volume A

name: NKBesicovitch.volume_slopeCone_le
statement:
theorem volume_slopeCone_le (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    volume {z : H × ℝ | z.2 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ z.2⁻¹ • z.1 ∈ A} ≤ volume A

name: NKBesicovitch.isBesicovitch_iff_unitDisk_subset
statement:
theorem isBesicovitch_iff_unitDisk_subset {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))} :
    IsBesicovitch k E ↔ ∀ V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), Module.finrank ℝ V = k →
      ∃ a, unitDisk V a ⊆ E

name: NKBesicovitch.isCompact_unitDisk
statement:
theorem isCompact_unitDisk (V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))

theorem unitDisk_eq_image (V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))

    unitDisk V a = (fun v : V ↦ a + v) '' Metric.closedBall (0 : V) 1

name: NKBesicovitch.lintegral_polar
statement:
theorem lintegral_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫⁻ w : sphere (0 : E) 1,
      ∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), f ((r : ℝ) • (w : E))
        ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) ∂μ.toSphere

name: NKBesicovitch.lintegral_volumeIoiPow_inv
statement:
theorem lintegral_volumeIoiPow_inv {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {f : Ioi (0 : ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ r, (ENNReal.ofReal (r : ℝ))⁻¹ * f r ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow m) =
      ∫⁻ r, f r ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (m - 1)

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.projection_rotate
statement:
theorem projection_rotate (u : Rotations n) (V : Grassmannian n k) :
    (rotate u V).projection =
      (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) * V.projection *
        (star u : Rotations n)

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.rotate_mul
statement:
theorem rotate_mul (u v : Rotations n) (V : Grassmannian n k) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.rotate_one

name: NKBesicovitch.preimage_plate_rotate
statement:
theorem preimage_plate_rotate (u : Rotations n) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))

    Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u ⁻¹' plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate u V).val

name: NKBesicovitch.preimage_unitDisk_rigidMotion
statement:
theorem preimage_unitDisk_rigidMotion (u : Rotations n) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))

name: NKBesicovitch.preimage_unitDisk_rotate
statement:
theorem preimage_unitDisk_rotate (u : Rotations n) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))

name: NKBesicovitch.rigidMotion_apply
statement:
theorem rigidMotion_apply (u : Rotations n) (a x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :

name: NKBesicovitch.volume_plate_rotate

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.continuous_normalLift
statement:
theorem continuous_normalLift (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) : Continuous (normalLift hv b (k := k))

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.mem_normalLift_iff
statement:
theorem mem_normalLift_iff (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    z ∈ (normalLift hv b V).val ↔
      ∃ x ∈ V.val, ∃ t : ℝ, normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t) = z

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.normalCoordinates_mem_normalLift_iff
statement:
theorem normalCoordinates_mem_normalLift_iff (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (t : ℝ) :
    normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t) ∈ (normalLift hv b V).val ↔ x ∈ V.val

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.projection_normalLift
statement:
theorem projection_normalLift (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k) :
    (normalLift hv b V).projection = (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      ((V.projection.prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)).comp
        (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)

name: NKBesicovitch.Grassmannian.projection_normalLift_apply
statement:
theorem projection_normalLift_apply (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (t : ℝ) :
    (normalLift hv b V).projection (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t)) =
      normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (V.projection x, t)

theorem normal_mem_normalLift (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)

statement:
theorem normalLiftCoordinates_apply (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.orthogonal_components_mem_of_mem_plate
statement:
theorem orthogonal_components_mem_of_mem_plate {a x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1) (hx : x ∈ plate δ V a) :
    V.orthogonalProjectionOnto (x - a) ∈ closedBall 0 2 ∧
      Vᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto (x - a) ∈ ball 0 δ

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.orthogonal_cylinder_subset_plate

theorem orthogonal_cylinder_subset_plate (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (δ : ℝ) :
    closedBall (0 : V) 1 ×ˢ ball (0 : Vᗮ) δ ⊆
      (fun z : V × Vᗮ ↦ a + (z.1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) + z.2) ⁻¹' plate δ V a

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.preimage_plate_subset_orthogonal_cylinder
statement:
theorem preimage_plate_subset_orthogonal_cylinder (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1) :
    (fun z : V × Vᗮ ↦ a + (z.1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) + z.2) ⁻¹' plate δ V a ⊆
      closedBall (0 : V) 2 ×ˢ ball (0 : Vᗮ) δ

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_plate_le_orthogonal_cylinder
statement:
theorem volume_plate_le_orthogonal_cylinder (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1) :
    volume (plate δ V a) ≤
      volume (closedBall (0 : V) 2) * volume (ball (0 : Vᗮ) δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.diskAverage_indicator_le_plateMaximal
statement:
theorem diskAverage_indicator_le_plateMaximal (hU : MeasurableSet U)
    (V : Grassmannian n k) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    diskAverage (U.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) V a ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * plateMaximal δ
        ((thickening δ U).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) V

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.disk_integral_mul_normal_volume_le
statement:
theorem disk_integral_mul_normal_volume_le (hU : MeasurableSet U)
    (V : Grassmannian n k) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (δ : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ v in closedBall (0 : V.val) 1, U.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) (a + v)) *
        volume (ball (0 : V.valᗮ) δ) ≤
      ∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val a, (thickening δ U).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) x

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_plate_le_two_pow_mul
statement:
theorem volume_plate_le_two_pow_mul (V : Grassmannian n k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1) :
    volume (plate δ V.val a) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * volume (closedBall (0 : V.val) 1) *
      volume (ball (0 : V.valᗮ) δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.measurable_eLpNorm_fiber
statement:
theorem measurable_eLpNorm_fiber [SFinite μ] (hf : Measurable f) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) : Measurable (fun y ↦ eLpNorm (fun x ↦ f (x, y)) r μ)

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_add_le [SFinite μ] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm (f + g) q r μ ν ≤ mixedNorm f q r μ ν + mixedNorm g q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_const_mul_le
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_const_mul_le (c : ℝ≥0) (f : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    mixedNorm (fun p ↦ c * f p) q r μ ν ≤ c * mixedNorm f q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_indicator_rpow
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_indicator_rpow {F : Set (X × Y)} (hF : MeasurableSet F)
    {q r : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    mixedNorm (F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) (ENNReal.ofReal q)
      (ENNReal.ofReal r) μ ν ^ q =
        ∫⁻ y, μ ((fun x ↦ (x, y)) ⁻¹' F) ^ (q / r) ∂ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_indicator_snd
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_indicator_snd {A : Set Y} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' A).indicator f) q r μ ν =
      mixedNorm f q r μ (ν.restrict A)

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_le_const_mul_of_fiber_ae
NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_mono
statement: theorem mixedNorm_mono (h : f ≤ g) : mixedNorm f q r μ ν ≤ mixedNorm g q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_mono_fiber_ae
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_mono_fiber_ae (h : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f (x, y) ≤ g (x, y)) :
    mixedNorm f q r μ ν ≤ mixedNorm g q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_iSup_directed
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_iSup_directed {f : ι → X → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i))
    (hd : Directed (· ≤ ·) f) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ⨆ i, f i x) p μ = ⨆ i, eLpNorm (f i) p μ

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_tsum_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_tsum_le {f : ι → X → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i))
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ∑' i, f i x) p μ ≤ ∑' i, eLpNorm (f i) p μ

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_sum_le
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_sum_le [SFinite μ] {f : ι → X × Y → ℝ≥0∞} (s : Finset ι)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, Measurable (f i)) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm (fun p ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i p) q r μ ν ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, mixedNorm (f i) q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_tsum_le
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_tsum_le [SFinite μ] {f : ι → X × Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm (fun p ↦ ∑' i, f i p) q r μ ν ≤ ∑' i, mixedNorm (f i) q r μ ν

name: NKBesicovitch.lowerSemicontinuous_lintegral
statement:
theorem lowerSemicontinuous_lintegral {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [FirstCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} {f : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hm : ∀ x, AEMeasurable (f x) μ) (hl : ∀ y, LowerSemicontinuous (fun x ↦ f x y)) :
    LowerSemicontinuous (fun x ↦ ∫⁻ y, f x y ∂μ)

name: NKBesicovitch.isOpen_setOf_mem_plate_rotate
NKBesicovitch.lowerSemicontinuous_plate_average_orbit
statement:
theorem lowerSemicontinuous_plate_average_orbit (δ : ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (V : Grassmannian n k) {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    LowerSemicontinuous (fun u : Rotations n ↦
      (∫⁻ x in plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate u V).val a, f x) /
        volume (plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate u V).val a))

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.one_le_tsum_diskAverage_of_cover
statement:
theorem one_le_tsum_diskAverage_of_cover (U : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (hU : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) (V : Grassmannian n k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hcover : unitDisk V.val a ⊆ ⋃ j, U j) :
    1 ≤ ∑' j, diskAverage ((U j).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) V a

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.one_le_tsum_plateMaximal_of_cover
statement:
theorem one_le_tsum_plateMaximal_of_cover (U : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (hU : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) (δ : ℕ → ℝ≥0)
    (hδ : ∀ j, 0 < δ j ∧ δ j ≤ 1) {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))}
    (hB : IsBesicovitch k E) (hcover : E ⊆ ⋃ j, U j) (V : Grassmannian n k) :
    1 ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * ∑' j, plateMaximal (δ j)
      ((thickening (δ j) (U j)).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) V

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.exists_ball_cover_of_measure_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ball_cover_of_measure_zero [Nonempty X] {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    {E : Set X} (hE : μH[s] E = 0) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (x : ℕ → X) (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ i, 0 < r i ∧ r i < 1) ∧
      E ⊆ ⋃ i, ball (x i) (r i) ∧ (∑' i, (r i : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s) < ε

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_thickening_ball_le_cost
statement:
theorem volume_thickening_ball_le_cost {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) {δ r : ℝ≥0} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hr : δ / 2 ≤ r) (hrδ : r ≤ δ) :
    volume (thickening δ (ball x r)) ≤
      (volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s)) *
          (δ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((n : ℝ) - s) * (r : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.volume_thickening_ball_union_le_cost
statement:
theorem volume_thickening_ball_union_le_cost {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (I : Set ℕ)
    {δ : ℝ≥0} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hr : ∀ i ∈ I, δ / 2 ≤ r i ∧ r i ≤ δ) :
    volume (thickening δ (⋃ i ∈ I, ball (x i) (r i))) ≤
      (volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s)) *
          (δ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((n : ℝ) - s) * (∑' i, (r i : ℝ≥0∞) ^ s)

name: NKBesicovitch.lintegral_eLpNorm_ball_rpow
statement:
theorem lintegral_eLpNorm_ball_rpow (R : ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫⁻ y, eLpNorm ((ball y R).indicator f) p volume ^ (p : ℝ)) =
      volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) R) * eLpNorm f p volume ^ (p : ℝ)

name: NKBesicovitch.lintegral_lintegral_ball_indicator
statement:
theorem lintegral_lintegral_ball_indicator (R : ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ y, ∫⁻ x, (ball y R).indicator f x) =
      volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) R) * ∫⁻ x, f x

name: NKBesicovitch.measurable_ball_indicator
statement:
theorem measurable_ball_indicator (R : ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measurable (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦
      (ball z.1 R).indicator f z.2)

name: NKBesicovitch.lowerSemicontinuous_plateAverage_ball_orbit
statement:
theorem lowerSemicontinuous_plateAverage_ball_orbit (δ R : ℝ)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (V : Grassmannian n k)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    LowerSemicontinuous (fun z : Rotations n × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦
      (∫⁻ x in plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate z.1 V).val a, (ball z.2 R).indicator f x) /
        volume (plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate z.1 V).val a))

name: NKBesicovitch.measurable_plateMaximal_ball_orbit
statement:
theorem measurable_plateMaximal_ball_orbit (δ R : ℝ) (V : Grassmannian n k)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measurable (fun z : Rotations n × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ↦
      plateMaximal δ ((ball z.2 R).indicator f) (Grassmannian.rotate z.1 V))

name: NKBesicovitch.plateAverage_le_plateMaximal_ball
statement:
theorem plateAverage_le_plateMaximal_ball (hδ : δ ≤ 1) (V : Grassmannian n k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hy : y ∈ ball a 1) :
    (∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val a, f x) / volume (plate δ V.val a) ≤
      plateMaximal δ ((ball y 3).indicator f) V

name: NKBesicovitch.plateMaximal_rpow_le_lintegral_ball
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_rpow_le_lintegral_ball (hδ : δ ≤ 1) (hp : 0 < p)
    (V : Grassmannian n k) :
    plateMaximal δ f V ^ p ≤
      (volume (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1))⁻¹ *
        ∫⁻ y, plateMaximal δ ((ball y 3).indicator f) V ^ p

name: NKBesicovitch.plateAverage_rotate
statement:
theorem plateAverage_rotate (u : Rotations n) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (V : Grassmannian n k) (δ : ℝ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ z in plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate u V).val (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u a), f z) /
        volume (plate δ (Grassmannian.rotate u V).val (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u a)) =
      (∫⁻ z in plate δ V.val a, f (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u z)) /
        volume (plate δ V.val a)

name: NKBesicovitch.plateMaximal_rotate
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_rotate (u : Rotations n) (V : Grassmannian n k) (δ : ℝ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    plateMaximal δ f (Grassmannian.rotate u V) =
      plateMaximal δ (f ∘ Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u) V

name: NKBesicovitch.plateAverage_add_right
statement:
theorem plateAverage_add_right (a y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (V : Grassmannian n k) (δ : ℝ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val (a + y), f x) / volume (plate δ V.val (a + y)) =
      (∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val a, f (x + y)) / volume (plate δ V.val a)

name: NKBesicovitch.plateMaximal_add_right
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_add_right (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (V : Grassmannian n k)
    (δ : ℝ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    plateMaximal δ (fun x ↦ f (x + y)) V = plateMaximal δ f V

name: NKBesicovitch.preimage_plate_add_right
statement:
theorem preimage_plate_add_right (a y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (δ : ℝ) :
    (fun x ↦ x + y) ⁻¹' plate δ V (a + y) = plate δ V a

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.dyadic_rpow_tsum_ne_top
statement:
theorem dyadic_rpow_tsum_ne_top {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, (((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ j : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ t) ≠ ∞

name: NKBesicovitch.Hausdorff.exists_dyadic_cover
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_cover {n : ℕ} (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i ∧ r i ≤ 1) :
    ∃ I : ℕ → Set ℕ, (∀ j i, i ∈ I j → (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ j / 2 ≤ r i ∧
        r i ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) ^ j) ∧
      (⋃ i, ball (x i) (r i)) ⊆ ⋃ j, ⋃ i ∈ I j, ball (x i) (r i)

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.fst_mem_unitDisk_of_normalCoordinates_mem
statement:
theorem fst_mem_unitDisk_of_normalCoordinates_mem (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {a z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ}
    (hz : normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b z ∈
      unitDisk (normalLift hv b V).val (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b a)) :
    z.1 ∈ unitDisk V.val a.1

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.normalCoordinates_half_disk_mem
statement:
theorem normalCoordinates_half_disk_mem (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} (hx : x ∈ unitDisk V.val 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • x, t) ∈
      unitDisk (normalLift hv b V).val 0

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.normalCoordinates_half_plate_mem
statement:
theorem normalCoordinates_half_plate_mem (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} (hx : x ∈ plate δ V.val 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • x, t) ∈

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.preimage_plate_normalCoordinates_subset
statement:
theorem preimage_plate_normalCoordinates_subset (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ) (δ : ℝ) :
    normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b ⁻¹'
        plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b a) ⊆
      plate δ V.val a.1 ×ˢ univ

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.half_pow_mul_volume_plate_le
statement:
theorem half_pow_mul_volume_plate_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ m * volume (plate δ V.val 0) ≤
      volume (plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val 0)

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.half_pow_mul_volume_plate_le_centers
statement:
theorem half_pow_mul_volume_plate_le_centers (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ m * volume (plate δ V.val a) ≤
      volume (plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val z)

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.lintegral_plate_normalLift_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_plate_normalLift_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ z in plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b a), f z) ≤
      ∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val a.1, ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t))

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.plateAverage_normalLift_le
statement:
theorem plateAverage_normalLift_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ z in plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b a), f z) /
        volume (plate δ (normalLift hv b V).val (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b a)) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m *
        ((∫⁻ x in plate δ V.val a.1, ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t))) /
          volume (plate δ V.val a.1))

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.plateMaximal_normalLift_le
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_normalLift_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (V : Grassmannian m k)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    plateMaximal δ f (normalLift hv b V) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m *
      plateMaximal δ (fun x ↦ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f (normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b (x, t))) V

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_iterated_eq_prod
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_iterated_eq_prod [SFinite ν] {f : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm (fun x ↦ eLpNorm (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) p ν) p μ = eLpNorm f p (μ.prod ν)

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_map_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_map_le (g : X → Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm f p (μ.map g) ≤ eLpNorm (f ∘ g) p μ

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_prod_le_iterated
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_prod_le_iterated (f : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm f p (μ.prod ν) ≤ eLpNorm (fun x ↦ eLpNorm (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) p ν) p μ

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.lintegral_normalize_direction
statement:
theorem lintegral_normalize_direction {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    {w : E} (hw : w ≠ 0) (x : E) :
    (∫⁻ s : ℝ, f (x + s • (‖w‖⁻¹ • w))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖w‖ * ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f (x + t • w)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.measurable_localXRay
statement:
theorem measurable_localXRay {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measurable (fun g : Line m ↦ localXRay f g.2 g.1)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.volume_lineTimes_le_one
statement:
theorem volume_lineTimes_le_one (E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)) (g : Line m) :
    volume (lineTimes E g) ≤ 1

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_vertical_translate
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_vertical_translate (hf : Measurable f) (a : ℝ) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ ↦ f (z.1, a + z.2)) p volume =
      eLpNorm f p volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.lintegral_unitInterval_eq_localXRay
statement:
theorem lintegral_unitInterval_eq_localXRay (hf : Measurable f) (a : ℝ)
    (ξ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (∫⁻ t in Icc a (a + 1), f (x + t • ξ, t)) =
      localXRay (fun z ↦ f (z.1, a + z.2)) ξ (x + a • ξ)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.mixedNorm_unitInterval_eq_localXRay
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_unitInterval_eq_localXRay (hf : Measurable f) (a : ℝ)
    (Ξ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))) (q r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
      (fun g : Line m ↦ ∫⁻ t in Icc a (a + 1), f (g.1 + t • g.2, t))) q r volume volume =
        mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator (fun g : Line m ↦
          localXRay (fun z ↦ f (z.1, a + z.2)) g.2 g.1)) q r volume volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.chartXRay_le_sum_unitIntervals
statement:
theorem chartXRay_le_sum_unitIntervals {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hsupport : Function.support f ⊆ K)
    {s : Finset ℝ} (hcover : ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ a ∈ s, z.2 ∈ Icc a (a + 1))
    (ξ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    chartXRay f ξ x ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ∫⁻ t in Icc a (a + 1), f (x + t • ξ, t)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.exists_finite_unitInterval_cover
NKBesicovitch.XRay.measurable_chartXRay
statement:
theorem measurable_chartXRay {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) : Measurable (fun g : Line m ↦ chartXRay f g.2 g.1)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.mixedNorm_chartXRay_le_sum_unitIntervals
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_chartXRay_le_sum_unitIntervals
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    (hsupport : Function.support f ⊆ K) {s : Finset ℝ}
    (hcover : ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ a ∈ s, z.2 ∈ Icc a (a + 1))
    {Ξ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))} (hΞ : MeasurableSet Ξ)
    {q r : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
      (fun g : Line m ↦ chartXRay f g.2 g.1)) q r volume volume ≤
        ∑ a ∈ s, mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
          (fun g : Line m ↦ ∫⁻ t in Icc a (a + 1), f (g.1 + t • g.2, t)))
            q r volume volume

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_le_comp_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_le_comp_of_norm_le (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (h : ∀ x, ‖e x‖ ≤ ‖x‖)
    {f : F → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm f p volume ≤ eLpNorm (f ∘ e) p volume

name: NKBesicovitch.volume_le_map_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem volume_le_map_of_norm_le (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (h : ∀ x, ‖e x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) :
    (volume : Measure F) ≤ (volume : Measure E).map e

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.injective_transverseProjection
statement:
theorem injective_transverseProjection (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective ((ℝ ∙ w)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.subtypeL)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.norm_transverseEquiv_le
statement:
theorem norm_transverseEquiv_le (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    ‖transverseEquiv hvw x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.sub_transverseEquiv_mem_span
statement:
theorem sub_transverseEquiv_mem_span (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    (x : E) - transverseEquiv hvw x ∈ ℝ ∙ w

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.surjective_transverseProjection
statement:
theorem surjective_transverseProjection (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective ((ℝ ∙ w)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.subtypeL)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.transverseEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem transverseEquiv_apply (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    transverseEquiv hvw x = (ℝ ∙ w)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto x

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_perpendicular_le_transverse
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_perpendicular_le_transverse (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0)
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (p : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm (fun y : (ℝ ∙ w)ᗮ ↦ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f ((y : E) + t • w)) p volume ≤
      eLpNorm (fun x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ ↦ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f ((x : E) + t • w)) p volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.lintegral_transverseEquiv
statement:
theorem lintegral_transverseEquiv (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) (f : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (x : (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) :
    (∫⁻ t : ℝ, f ((transverseEquiv hvw x : E) + t • w)) =
      ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f ((x : E) + t • w)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.chartXRay_normalCoordinates
statement:
theorem chartXRay_normalCoordinates (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) (f : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (ξ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    chartXRay (f ∘ normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b) ξ x =
      ∫⁻ t : ℝ, f ((b x : E) + t • ((b ξ : E) + v))

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_perpendicular_normalDirection_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_perpendicular_normalDirection_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    directionXRayNorm f r (normalDirection hv (b ξ)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ‖(b ξ : E) + v‖ *
          eLpNorm (chartXRay (f ∘ normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b) ξ) r volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_directionXRayNorm_cap_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_directionXRayNorm_cap_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
    {A : Set (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcap : ∀ ξ ∈ A, c ≤ ⟪v, (normalDirection hv ξ : E)⟫_ℝ)
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (q r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm (directionXRayNorm f r) q
        ((volume : Measure E).toSphere.restrict (normalDirection hv '' A)) ≤
      ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / q.toReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / c)) *
        mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' (b ⁻¹' A)).indicator
          (fun g : Line m ↦ chartXRay (f ∘ normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b) g.2 g.1))
            q r volume volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_directionXRayNorm_slope_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_directionXRayNorm_slope_le (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ)
    {A : Set (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcap : ∀ ξ ∈ A, c ≤ ⟪v, (normalDirection hv ξ : E)⟫_ℝ)
    {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (q r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm (directionXRayNorm f r ∘ normalDirection hv) q (volume.restrict A) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / c) * mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' (b ⁻¹' A)).indicator
        (fun g : Line m ↦ chartXRay (f ∘ normalCoordinatesWithBasis hv b) g.2 g.1))
          q r volume volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.directionXRayNorm_rotate
statement:
theorem directionXRayNorm_rotate {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) (r : ℝ≥0∞) (u : Rotations n)
    (v : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :
    directionXRayNorm f r (Rotations.rotateSphere u v) =
      directionXRayNorm (f ∘ Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u) r v

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.eLpNorm_frameXRay
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_frameXRay {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) (u : Rotations n) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    eLpNorm (frameXRay v b f u) r volume =
      directionXRayNorm (f ∘ Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv u) r v

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.measurable_frameXRay
statement:
theorem measurable_frameXRay {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞}

NKBesicovitch.Induction.plateMaximal_flagDirection_le
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_flagDirection_le {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (u : Rotations n) (V : Grassmannian m k) :
    plateMaximal δ f (flagDirection (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v) b (u, V)) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * plateMaximal δ (frameXRay v b f u) V

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_plateMaximal_le_of_power
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_plateMaximal_le_of_power (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    {p q A : ℝ≥0∞} {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))}
    {ν : Measure (Grassmannian n k)}
    (hbound : ∀ g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g →
      Function.support g ⊆ K → eLpNorm (plateMaximal δ g) q ν ≤ A * eLpNorm g p volume)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hs : Function.support f ⊆ K) :
    eLpNorm (plateMaximal δ f) (q * ENNReal.ofReal t) ν ≤
      A ^ t⁻¹ * eLpNorm f (p * ENNReal.ofReal t) volume

name: NKBesicovitch.plateAverage_rpow_le
statement:
theorem plateAverage_rpow_le (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (V : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hf : Measurable f) :
    ((∫⁻ x in plate δ V a, f x) / volume (plate δ V a)) ^ t ≤
      (∫⁻ x in plate δ V a, f x ^ t) / volume (plate δ V a)

name: NKBesicovitch.plateMaximal_rpow_le
statement:
theorem plateMaximal_rpow_le (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hf : Measurable f)
    (V : Grassmannian n k) :
    plateMaximal δ f V ^ t ≤ plateMaximal δ (fun x ↦ f x ^ t) V

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.exists_projectionExponent_for_dimension
statement:
theorem exists_projectionExponent_for_dimension {n k : ℕ}
    (h : (n : ℝ) < criticalExponent ^ (k - 1) + (k : ℝ)) :
    ∃ β ∈ Ioo projectionExponent 2,
      (n : ℝ) < (β / (β - 1)) ^ (k - 1) + (k : ℝ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.exists_projectionExponent_for_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_projectionExponent_for_ratio {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ∈ Ioo 2 criticalExponent) :
    ∃ β ∈ Ioo projectionExponent 2, 1 < ρ * (β - 1) ∧ ρ * (β - 1) < β

name: NKBesicovitch.Induction.exists_ratio_lt_criticalExponent
NKBesicovitch.lintegral_rpow_le_measure_mul
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_le_measure_mul {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) ^ t ≤ μ univ ^ (t - 1) * ∫⁻ x, f x ^ t ∂μ

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.directionXRayNorm_rpow_le
statement:
theorem directionXRayNorm_rpow_le (ht : 1 ≤ t) (R : ℝ≥0) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hs : Function.support f ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ)) (w : sphere (0 : E) 1) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    directionXRayNorm f (r * ENNReal.ofReal t) w ^ t ≤
      ((2 * R : ℝ≥0) ^ (t - 1) : ℝ≥0) * directionXRayNorm (fun x ↦ f x ^ t) r w

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.lineIntegral_rpow_le
statement:
theorem lineIntegral_rpow_le (ht : 1 ≤ t) (R : ℝ≥0) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hs : Function.support f ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ))
    (w : sphere (0 : E) 1) (y : (ℝ ∙ (w : E))ᗮ) :
    (∫⁻ s : ℝ, f ((y : E) + s • (w : E))) ^ t ≤
      ((2 * R : ℝ≥0) ^ (t - 1) : ℝ≥0) *
        ∫⁻ s : ℝ, f ((y : E) + s • (w : E)) ^ t

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.sphericalXRayNorm_le_of_power
statement:
theorem sphericalXRayNorm_le_of_power (ht : 1 ≤ t) (R : ℝ≥0) {p q r A : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hbound : ∀ g : E → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g →
      Function.support g ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ) →
        sphericalXRayNorm g q r ≤ A * eLpNorm g p volume)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hs : Function.support f ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ)) :
    sphericalXRayNorm f (q * ENNReal.ofReal t) (r * ENNReal.ofReal t) ≤
      (((2 * R : ℝ≥0) ^ (t - 1) : ℝ≥0) * A) ^ t⁻¹ *
        eLpNorm f (p * ENNReal.ofReal t) volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.sphericalXRayNorm_rpow_le
statement:
theorem sphericalXRayNorm_rpow_le (ht : 1 ≤ t) (R : ℝ≥0) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hs : Function.support f ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ)) (q r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    sphericalXRayNorm f (q * ENNReal.ofReal t) (r * ENNReal.ofReal t) ^ t ≤
      ((2 * R : ℝ≥0) ^ (t - 1) : ℝ≥0) * sphericalXRayNorm (fun x ↦ f x ^ t) q r

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.support_lineIntegrand_subset
statement:
theorem support_lineIntegrand_subset {R : ℝ}
    (hs : Function.support f ⊆ closedBall 0 R)
    (w : sphere (0 : E) 1) (y : (ℝ ∙ (w : E))ᗮ) :
    Function.support (fun s : ℝ ↦ f ((y : E) + s • (w : E))) ⊆ Icc (-R) R

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_le_sum_restrict
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_le_sum_restrict (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Set X)
    (hcover : ∀ x, ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ A i) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm f p μ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, eLpNorm f p (μ.restrict (A i))

name: NKBesicovitch.eLpNorm_restrict_union_le
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_restrict_union_le (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) (A B : Set X)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpfin : p ≠ ∞) :
    eLpNorm f p (μ.restrict (A ∪ B)) ≤
      eLpNorm f p (μ.restrict A) + eLpNorm f p (μ.restrict B)

name: NKBesicovitch.interpolate_block_bounds
statement:
theorem interpolate_block_bounds {N C V s a S : ℝ≥0∞} {q β θ : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (hgeometry : N ^ q ≤ C * V ^ β)
    (helementary : N ^ q ≤ s ^ q * a ^ (β - 1) * S) :
    N ≤ C ^ (θ / q) * V ^ (β * θ / q) * s ^ (1 - θ) *
      a ^ ((β - 1) * (1 - θ) / q) * S ^ ((1 - θ) / q)

name: NKBesicovitch.interpolate_power_bounds
NKBesicovitch.le_geometric_mean
statement:
theorem le_geometric_mean {N A B : ℝ≥0∞} {θ : ℝ} (hA : N ≤ A) (hB : N ≤ B)
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) : N ≤ A ^ θ * B ^ (1 - θ)

name: NKBesicovitch.normalize_dyadic_block_bound
statement:
theorem normalize_dyadic_block_bound {N A S : ℝ≥0∞} {s B t u v : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (h : ENNReal.ofReal (s / 2) * N ≤ A * ENNReal.ofReal (s / 2) ^ u *
      ENNReal.ofReal (B * t) ^ v * S) :
    ENNReal.ofReal s * N ≤ (2 * A * ENNReal.ofReal B ^ v * S) *
      ENNReal.ofReal s ^ u * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ v

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_double_dyadic_constant
statement:
theorem exists_double_dyadic_constant {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ A : ℝ≥0∞,
      (∑' j : ℕ, ∑' l : ℕ, A * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ u *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l) ^ v) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * A

name: NKBesicovitch.tsum_dyadic_rpow_ne_top
statement:
theorem tsum_dyadic_rpow_ne_top {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ u) ≠ ∞

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_interpolated_series_constant
statement:
theorem exists_interpolated_series_constant {C S : ℝ≥0∞} {B q β θ : ℝ}
    (hC : C ≠ ∞) (hS : S ≠ ∞) (hB : 0 < B) (hq : 0 < q) (hβ : 1 < β)
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ (V : ℝ≥0∞) (N : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞),
      (∀ j l, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2) * N j l ≤
        C ^ (θ / q) * V ^ (β * θ / q) * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2) ^ (1 - θ) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l) ^ ((β - 1) * (1 - θ) / q) *
            S ^ ((1 - θ) / q)) →
      (∑' j : ℕ, ∑' l : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) * N j l) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal D * V ^ (β * θ / q)

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_dyadic_scale
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_scale {x B : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hB : 0 < B) (hxB : x ≤ B) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / 2 < x ∧ x ≤ B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: NKBesicovitch.exists_dyadic_scale_ennreal
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_scale_ennreal {x : ℝ≥0∞} {B : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hxB : x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / 2) < x ∧
      x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)

name: NKBesicovitch.lintegral_rpow_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_le_of_gap {f : Y → ℝ≥0∞} {a s : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (hfin : ∀ y, f y ≠ ∞)
    (hgap : ∀ y, f y = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ f y) :
    (∫⁻ y, f y ^ s ∂ν) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ (s - 1)) * ∫⁻ y, f y ∂ν

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_indicator_rpow_le_of_fiber_gap
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_indicator_rpow_le_of_fiber_gap [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    {F : Set (X × Y)} (hF : MeasurableSet F) {q r a : ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (hqr : q / r ≤ 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hfin : ∀ y, μ ((fun x ↦ (x, y)) ⁻¹' F) ≠ ∞)
    (hgap : ∀ y, μ ((fun x ↦ (x, y)) ⁻¹' F) = 0 ∨
      ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ μ ((fun x ↦ (x, y)) ⁻¹' F)) :
    mixedNorm (F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) (ENNReal.ofReal q)
      (ENNReal.ofReal r) μ ν ^ q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ (q / r - 1)) * μ.prod ν F

name: NKBesicovitch.mixedNorm_indicator_rpow_le_of_fiber_upper
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_indicator_rpow_le_of_fiber_upper
    {F : Set (X × Y)} (hF : MeasurableSet F) {Ξ : Set Y} (hΞ : MeasurableSet Ξ)
    (hsub : ∀ p ∈ F, p.2 ∈ Ξ) {q r : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) {B : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hupper : ∀ y, μ ((fun x ↦ (x, y)) ⁻¹' F) ≤ B) :
    mixedNorm (F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) (ENNReal.ofReal q)

      if ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) < volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' F) ∧
        volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a
      then volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' F) else 0

statement:
theorem indicator_le_tsum_fiberBlock_ae (F : Set (Line m)) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hupper : ∀ ξ, volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) (x, ξ) ≤
      ∑' l : ℕ, (fiberBlock F (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l)).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) (x, ξ)

    (hupper : ∀ ξ, volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B)
    {q r : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm (F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) q r volume volume ≤
      ∑' l : ℕ, mixedNorm ((fiberBlock F (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l)).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) q r volume volume

    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ K →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m),

    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ K →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → richLines E Ξ r ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 R ×ˢ Ξ

statement:
theorem indicator_localXRay_le_tsum_richLines
    {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (Ξ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))) (g : Line m) :
    (Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
      (fun g : Line m ↦ localXRay (E.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) g.2 g.1) g ≤
        ∑' j : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) *
          (richLines E Ξ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2)).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) g

statement:

    {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)} (hE : MeasurableSet E)

    {q r : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
      (fun g : Line m ↦ localXRay (E.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) g.2 g.1))
        q r volume volume ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) *
          mixedNorm ((richLines E Ξ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2)).indicator
            (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) q r volume volume

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.mixedNorm_localXRay_le_double_sum
statement:
theorem mixedNorm_localXRay_le_double_sum {m : ℕ}
    {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    {Ξ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))} (hΞ : MeasurableSet Ξ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hupper : ∀ (j : ℕ) (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)),
      volume ((fun x ↦ (x, ξ)) ⁻¹' richLines E Ξ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B)
    {q r : ℝ≥0∞} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hqfin : q ≠ ∞) (hrfin : r ≠ ∞) :
    mixedNorm ((Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ξ).indicator
      (fun g : Line m ↦ localXRay (E.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) g.2 g.1))
        q r volume volume ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ∑' l : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) *
          mixedNorm ((fiberBlock (richLines E Ξ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j / 2))
            (B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ l)).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) q r volume volume

NKBesicovitch.Projection.mem_pairFiber_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pairFiber_iff {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (c : ℝ) (W : Set (PairCoordinates m))
    (g : Line m) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    g ∈ pairFiber a b c W z ↔ ∃ p ∈ W, lineAt a p.1 p.2.1 = g ∧ pairCode a b c p = z

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairCode_dual_coefficient
statement:
theorem pairCode_dual_coefficient {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) :
    (b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a) = c * (t - b) / (t - a)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairCode_eq_dual_projections
statement:
theorem pairCode_eq_dual_projections {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (p : PairCoordinates m) :
    pairCode a b c p =
      (c * (b - a) / (t - a)) • atHeight t (lineAt a p.1 p.2.1) +
      ((b - a) / (dualTime a b c t - a)) •
        atHeight (dualTime a b c t) (lineAt a p.1 p.2.2)

statement:
theorem coordinates_bound_of_measure_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hmeasure : ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ volume I)
    {σ : Fin D → ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ S.select I) (j : Fin D) :
    |σ j| ≤ S.upperConstant * (r⁻¹) ^ S.boundExponent

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.estimate_of_measure_lower
statement:
theorem estimate_of_measure_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hmeasure : ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ volume I)
    {σ : Fin D → ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ S.select I) {G : Set (Line m)} (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hGb : IsBounded G) :
    (volume G).toReal ≤ (S.upperConstant * (r⁻¹) ^ S.boundExponent) *
      (parallelMultiplicity G).toReal ^ (2 - β) *
      (sliceSize (Finset.univ.image (S.time σ)) G).toReal ^ β

statement:

statement:
theorem exists_common_parameter {F : Set (Line m)} (hF : MeasurableSet F)

name: NKBesicovitch.XRay.estimate_commonLines_goodTimes
statement:
theorem estimate_commonLines_goodTimes (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hβ2 : β ≤ 2)
    {E : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) × ℝ)} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    {F : Set (Line m)} (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hFb : IsBounded F)
    {N r : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hmeasure : ∀ g ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ volume (goodTimes E (ENNReal.ofReal N) g))
    (σ : Fin D → ℝ) :
    (volume (S.commonLines F (goodTimes E (ENNReal.ofReal N)) σ)).toReal ≤
      (S.upperConstant * r⁻¹ ^ S.boundExponent) *
        (parallelMultiplicity F).toReal ^ (2 - β) * N ^ β

    (hmeasure : ∀ g ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ volume (goodTimes E N g))

    volume (atHeight (S.time σ i) '' S.commonLines F (goodTimes E N) σ) ≤ N

statement:

      (r / 2) ^ (S.volumeExponent + S.boundExponent * D) * (volume F).toReal ≤

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pair_amplification
statement:
theorem pair_amplification {β A D L M N H R q ℓ : ℝ} (hβ : 1 < β)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R) (hq : 0 < q) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hseed : H ≤ A * M ^ (2 - β) * (H / (q * ℓ)) ^ β)
    (hcode : H ≤ D * M * N) (hmass : L ^ 2 ≤ R * ℓ * N ^ 3) :
    L ≤ ((A * D ^ (β - 1)) * (R / q) ^ β) ^ (1 / (2 * β)) *
      M ^ (1 / (2 * β)) * N ^ (2 - 1 / (2 * β))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pair_mass_power_bound
statement:
theorem pair_mass_power_bound {β K L M N R q ℓ : ℝ} (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hR : 0 < R) (hq : 0 < q) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hmass : L ^ 2 ≤ R * ℓ * N ^ 3)
    (hthreshold : (q * ℓ) ^ β ≤ K * M * N ^ (β - 1)) :
    L ^ (2 * β) ≤ (K * (R / q) ^ β) * M * N ^ (4 * β - 1)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pair_take_root
statement:
theorem pair_take_root {β K L M N : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (hpower : L ^ (2 * β) ≤ K * M * N ^ (4 * β - 1)) :
    L ≤ K ^ (1 / (2 * β)) * M ^ (1 / (2 * β)) * N ^ (2 - 1 / (2 * β))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pair_threshold_bound

    (hseed : H ≤ A * M ^ (2 - β) * (H / (q * ℓ)) ^ β) :
    (q * ℓ) ^ β ≤ A * M ^ (2 - β) * H ^ (β - 1)

    (hseed : H ≤ A * M ^ (3 - β) * (H / τ) ^ β) (hcode : H ≤ D * M * N * Q) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.inverse_density_threshold

theorem inverse_density_threshold {β A a ℓ V : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (ha : 0 < a) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    V / (((a * ℓ) ^ β / A) ^ (1 / (β - 1))) =
      (A ^ (1 / (β - 1)) / a ^ (β / (β - 1))) * V * ℓ ^ (-(β / (β - 1)))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.monomial_bound_of_auxiliary_power

    (hlower : A * L ^ l * N ^ n ≤ T) (hupper : T ^ q ≤ D * L ^ u * N ^ v) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.corner_amplification
statement:
theorem corner_amplification {q A D L N τ ρ J : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hA : 0 < A) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hL : 0 < L) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hlower : A * L ^ (1 + 2 * q) *
      N ^ (-2 - 3 * q + ρ * q - (200 * q + 2) / J) ≤ τ)
    (hupper : τ ^ q ≤ D * L ^ 2 * N ^ (-2 + ρ)) :
    L ≤ (D / A ^ q) ^ (1 / (q + 2 * q ^ 2 - 2)) *
      N ^ ((2 * q + 3 * q ^ 2 - 2 + (200 * q ^ 2 + 2 * q) / J) /
        (q + 2 * q ^ 2 - 2))

statement:
theorem corner_mass_power_bound {q A D L N τ ρ J : ℝ}

    (hlower : A * L ^ (1 + 2 * q) *
      N ^ (-2 - 3 * q + ρ * q - (200 * q + 2) / J) ≤ τ)
    (hupper : τ ^ q ≤ D * L ^ 2 * N ^ (-2 + ρ)) :
    L ^ (q + 2 * q ^ 2 - 2) ≤ (D / A ^ q) *
      N ^ (2 * q + 3 * q ^ 2 - 2 - ρ * (q ^ 2 - 1) + (200 * q ^ 2 + 2 * q) / J)

theorem corner_mass_power_bound_uniform {q A D L N τ ρ J : ℝ}

statement:
theorem lintegral_pairDensity {a s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ a) (ht : t ≠ a)
    {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W) :

statement:

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairDensity_inter_preimage
statement:
theorem pairDensity_inter_preimage {a s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ a) (ht : t ≠ a)
    (W : Set (PairCoordinates m)) (B : Set (Line m)) (yz : Line m) :
    pairDensity a s t (W ∩ pairProjections a s t ⁻¹' B) yz =
      B.indicator (pairDensity a s t W) yz

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairDensity_le_projection
NKBesicovitch.Projection.pairProjections_mem_prod
statement:
theorem pairProjections_mem_prod (a s t : ℝ) {G : Set (Line m)}
    {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hWG : W ⊆ pairFamily a G)
    {p : PairCoordinates m} (hp : p ∈ W) :
    pairProjections a s t p ∈ (atHeight s '' G) ×ˢ (atHeight t '' G)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.setLIntegral_pairDensity
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_pairDensity {a s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ a) (ht : t ≠ a)
    {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W)
    {B : Set (Line m)} (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (∫⁻ yz in B, pairDensity a s t W yz) =
      volume (W ∩ pairProjections a s t ⁻¹' B)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.support_pairDensity_subset
statement:
theorem support_pairDensity_subset {a s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ a) (ht : t ≠ a)
    {G : Set (Line m)} {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hWG : W ⊆ pairFamily a G) :
    Function.support (pairDensity a s t W) ⊆ (atHeight s '' G) ×ˢ (atHeight t '' G)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.setLIntegral_lt_le_mul_measure
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_lt_le_mul_measure {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {μ : Measure X} {f : X → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) {S : Set X}
    (hS : Function.support f ⊆ S) (ℓ : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x | f x < ℓ}, f x ∂μ) ≤ ℓ * μ S

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.volume_low_pairDensity_le
statement:
theorem volume_low_pairDensity_le {a s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ a) (ht : t ≠ a)
    {G : Set (Line m)} {W : Set (PairCoordinates m)} (hW : MeasurableSet W)
    (hWG : W ⊆ pairFamily a G) (ℓ : ℝ≥0∞) :
    volume (W ∩ {p | pairDensity a s t W (pairProjections a s t p) < ℓ}) ≤
      ℓ * (volume (atHeight s '' G) * volume (atHeight t '' G))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.half_volume_le_separatedTimes_pair
statement:
theorem half_volume_le_separatedTimes_pair {I : Set ℝ} (a c : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((volume I).toReal / 2) ≤
      volume (separatedTimes I ![a, c] Finset.univ ((volume I).toReal / 100))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_separatedTimes
statement:
theorem measurableSet_separatedTimes {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι) (r : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (separatedTimes I a F r)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_separatedTimes_family
statement:
theorem measurableSet_separatedTimes_family {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {I : Set (X × ℝ)} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {a : X → ι → ℝ} (F : Finset ι)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ F, Measurable (fun x ↦ a x i)) {r : X → ℝ} (hr : Measurable r) :
    MeasurableSet {p : X × ℝ | p.2 ∈ separatedTimes {t | (p.1, t) ∈ I} (a p.1) F (r p.1)}

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.mem_separatedTimes
statement:
theorem mem_separatedTimes {I : Set ℝ} {a : ι → ℝ} {F : Finset ι} {r t : ℝ} :
    t ∈ separatedTimes I a F r ↔ t ∈ I ∧ ∀ i ∈ F, r ≤ dist t (a i)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.separatedTimes_eq_sdiff
statement:
theorem separatedTimes_eq_sdiff (I : Set ℝ) (a : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι) (r : ℝ) :
    separatedTimes I a F r = I \ ⋃ i ∈ F, Metric.ball (a i) r

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_separatedTimes_lower
statement:
theorem volume_separatedTimes_lower (I : Set ℝ) (a : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (volume I).toReal - 2 * r * F.card ≤ (volume (separatedTimes I a F r)).toReal

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualPairParameters_ne
statement:
theorem dualPairParameters_ne {I : Set ℝ} (hIpos : 0 < volume I) (hIfin : volume I ≠ ∞)
    {a b : ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ dualPairParameters I a b) :
    p.1 ≠ a ∧ p.1 ≠ b ∧ p.2 ≠ a ∧ p.2 ≠ b ∧ p.1 ≠ p.2

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualPairParameters_spec
statement:
theorem dualPairParameters_spec {I : Set ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ dualPairParameters I a b) :
    p.1 ∈ I ∧ p.2 ∈ I ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.1 a ∧ (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.1 b ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.2 a ∧ (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.2 b ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.1 p.2

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.half_square_le_volume_dualPairParameters
statement:
theorem half_square_le_volume_dualPairParameters {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIfin : volume I ≠ ∞) (a b : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((volume I).toReal ^ 2 / 2) ≤ volume (dualPairParameters I a b)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_dualPairParameters
statement:
theorem measurableSet_dualPairParameters {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b : ℝ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_dualPairParameters_family
statement:
theorem measurableSet_dualPairParameters_family {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {I : Set (X × ℝ)} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {a b : X → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hb : Measurable b) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualScalar_dualTime
statement:
theorem dualScalar_dualTime {a b c t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hta : t ≠ a)
    (htb : t ≠ b) : dualScalar a b t (dualTime a b c t) = c

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualScalar_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dualScalar_ne_zero {a b t u : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b)
    (hua : u ≠ a) : dualScalar a b t u ≠ 0

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTime_dualScalar
statement:
theorem dualTime_dualScalar {a b t u : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) :
    dualTime a b (dualScalar a b t u) t = u

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.hasDerivAt_dualScalar
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_dualScalar (a b t : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hua : u ≠ a) :
    HasDerivAt (dualScalar a b t) (-((b - a) * (t - a) / (t - b)) / (u - a) ^ 2) u

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.image_dualScalar
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.injOn_dualScalar
statement:
theorem injOn_dualScalar {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) :
    InjOn (dualScalar a b t) {u | u ≠ a}

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurable_dualScalar
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurable_dualTime
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_image_dualScalar
statement:
theorem volume_image_dualScalar {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b)
    {S : Set ℝ} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hSa : ∀ u ∈ S, u ≠ a) :
    volume (dualScalar a b t '' S) =
      ∫⁻ u in S, ENNReal.ofReal (|-((b - a) * (t - a) / (t - b)) / (u - a) ^ 2|)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualScalar_bounds
statement:
theorem dualScalar_bounds {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ dualPairParameters I a b) :
    δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ≤ |dualScalar a b p.1 p.2| ∧
      |dualScalar a b p.1 p.2| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2 ∧
      δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ≤
        |-((b - a) * (p.1 - a) / (p.1 - b)) / (p.2 - a) ^ 2|

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimeRelation_scalar_bounds
statement:
theorem dualTimeRelation_scalar_bounds {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ dualTimeRelation I a b) :
    δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ≤ |p.2| ∧ |p.2| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimeRelation_section
statement:
theorem dualTimeRelation_section {I : Set ℝ} {a b t : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) (hIfin : volume I ≠ ∞) :
    Prod.mk t ⁻¹' dualTimeRelation I a b =
      dualScalar a b t '' (Prod.mk t ⁻¹' dualPairParameters I a b)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimeRelation_subset
statement:
theorem dualTimeRelation_subset {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I)
    {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    dualTimeRelation I a b ⊆
      I ×ˢ Icc (-((100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2)) ((100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_dualTimeRelation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_dualTimeRelation {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b : ℝ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_dualTimeRelation_family
statement:
theorem measurableSet_dualTimeRelation_family {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {I : Set (X × ℝ)} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {a b : X → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hb : Measurable b) :
    MeasurableSet {p : X × (ℝ × ℝ) |
      p.2 ∈ dualTimeRelation {t | (p.1, t) ∈ I} (a p.1) (b p.1)}

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_dualTimeRelation_lower
statement:
theorem volume_dualTimeRelation_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_dualTimeRelation_ne_top
statement:
theorem volume_dualTimeRelation_ne_top {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) : volume (dualTimeRelation I a b) ≠ ∞

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_dualTimeRelation_section_lower
statement:
theorem volume_dualTimeRelation_section_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) (t : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100)) *
      volume (Prod.mk t ⁻¹' dualPairParameters I a b) ≤
        volume (Prod.mk t ⁻¹' dualTimeRelation I a b)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_separatedTriples
statement:
theorem measurableSet_separatedTriples {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (r : ℝ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_separatedTriples_family
statement:
theorem measurableSet_separatedTriples_family {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {I : Set (X × ℝ)} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {r : X → ℝ} (hr : Measurable r) :

      p.2 ∈ separatedTriples {t | (p.1, t) ∈ I} (r p.1)}

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.mem_separatedTriples
statement:
theorem mem_separatedTriples {I : Set ℝ} {r : ℝ} {p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ} :
    p ∈ separatedTriples I r ↔ p.1.1 ∈ I ∧ p.1.2 ∈ I ∧ p.2 ∈ I ∧
      r ≤ dist p.1.1 p.1.2 ∧ r ≤ dist p.1.1 p.2 ∧ r ≤ dist p.1.2 p.2

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.quarter_cube_le_volume_separatedTriples
statement:
theorem quarter_cube_le_volume_separatedTriples {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIfin : volume I ≠ ∞) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((volume I).toReal ^ 3 / 4) ≤
      volume (separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_separatedTriples
statement:
theorem volume_separatedTriples {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (r : ℝ) :
    volume (separatedTriples I r) =
      ∫⁻ p in separatedPairs I r, volume (separatedTimes I ![p.1, p.2] Finset.univ r)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimes_mem_separatedTriples
statement:
theorem dualTimes_mem_separatedTriples {I : Set ℝ} {a b c t : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ I)
    (ht : t ∈ dualTimes I a b c) :
    ((a, t), dualTime a b c t) ∈ separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimes_spec
statement:
theorem dualTimes_spec {I : Set ℝ} {a b c t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ dualTimes I a b c) :
    c ≠ 0 ∧ t ∈ I ∧ dualTime a b c t ∈ I ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist t a ∧ (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist t b ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist (dualTime a b c t) a ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist (dualTime a b c t) b ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist t (dualTime a b c t)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualTimes_subset
statement: theorem dualTimes_subset (I : Set ℝ) (a b c : ℝ) : dualTimes I a b c ⊆ I

statement:
theorem lintegral_volume_dualTimes {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b : ℝ) :

theorem measurableSet_dualTimes {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b c : ℝ) :

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.support_volume_dualTimes_subset
statement:
theorem support_volume_dualTimes_subset {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    Function.support (fun c ↦ volume (dualTimes I a b c)) ⊆

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualReservoir_scalar_bounds
statement:
theorem dualReservoir_scalar_bounds {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ dualReservoir I a b δ) :
    c ≠ 0 ∧ δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ≤ |c| ∧
      |c| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.dualReservoir_spec
statement:
theorem dualReservoir_spec {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ I) (hb : b ∈ I)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    MeasurableSet (dualReservoir I a b δ) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 2 / 400) ≤ volume (dualReservoir I a b δ) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 3 / 400) ≤
        (∫⁻ c in dualReservoir I a b δ, volume (dualTimes I a b c)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ dualReservoir I a b δ, c ≠ 0 ∧
        δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ≤ |c| ∧ |c| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 2 ∧
        MeasurableSet (dualTimes I a b c) ∧ dualTimes I a b c ⊆ I ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000) ≤ volume (dualTimes I a b c)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.lintegral_dualTimes_discarded_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_dualTimes_discarded_le {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

theorem lintegral_dualTimes_retained_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

theorem volume_dualReservoir_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_dualReservoir_ne_top
statement:
theorem volume_dualReservoir_ne_top {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) : volume (dualReservoir I a b δ) ≠ ∞

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerInnerCoefficient_swap
statement:
theorem cornerInnerCoefficient_swap {a c u : ℝ} (hua : u ≠ a) (huc : u ≠ c) (κ : ℝ) :
    cornerInnerCoefficient c a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u) u = κ

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.corner_scalar_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem corner_scalar_ratio_bounds {a c u r : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hu : u ∈ Icc 0 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hua : r ≤ dist u a) (huc : r ≤ dist u c) :
    r ≤ |(u - a) / (u - c)| ∧ |(u - a) / (u - c)| ≤ r⁻¹

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurable_cornerInnerCoefficient
statement:
theorem measurable_cornerInnerCoefficient {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {a c κ u : X → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hc : Measurable c) (hκ : Measurable κ)
    (hu : Measurable u) :
    Measurable (fun x ↦ cornerInnerCoefficient (a x) (c x) (κ x) (u x))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_preimage_cornerInnerCoefficient
statement:
theorem volume_preimage_cornerInnerCoefficient {a c u : ℝ} (hua : u ≠ a) (huc : u ≠ c)
    (S : Set ℝ) :
    volume ((fun κ ↦ cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u) ⁻¹' S) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |(u - a) / (u - c)| * volume S

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerTimeRelation_scalar_bounds
statement:
theorem cornerTimeRelation_scalar_bounds {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ) :
    p.2 ≠ 0 ∧ δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ^ 2 ≤ |p.2| ∧
      |p.2| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 3

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerTimeRelation_section
statement:
theorem cornerTimeRelation_section {I : Set ℝ} {a b c δ u : ℝ}
    (hu : u ∈ separatedTimes I ![a, c] Finset.univ ((volume I).toReal / 100)) :
    Prod.mk u ⁻¹' cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ =
      (fun κ ↦ cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u) ⁻¹' dualReservoir I b a δ

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerTimeRelation_spec
statement:
theorem cornerTimeRelation_spec {I : Set ℝ} {a b c δ : ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ) :
    p.1 ∈ I ∧ (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.1 a ∧
      (volume I).toReal / 100 ≤ dist p.1 c ∧
      cornerInnerCoefficient a c p.2 p.1 ∈ dualReservoir I b a δ

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_cornerTimeRelation
statement:
theorem measurableSet_cornerTimeRelation {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b c δ : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurableSet_cornerTimeRelation_family
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_cornerTimeRelation
statement:
theorem volume_cornerTimeRelation {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (a b c δ : ℝ) :
    volume (cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ) =
      ∫⁻ u in separatedTimes I ![a, c] Finset.univ ((volume I).toReal / 100),
        volume ((fun κ ↦ cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u) ⁻¹' dualReservoir I b a δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_cornerTimeRelation_lower
statement:
theorem volume_cornerTimeRelation_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 4 / 80000) ≤
      volume (cornerTimeRelation I a b c δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.volume_corner_scalar_preimage_lower
statement:
theorem volume_corner_scalar_preimage_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a c u : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hu : u ∈ separatedTimes I ![a, c] Finset.univ ((volume I).toReal / 100)) (S : Set ℝ) :

      volume ((fun κ ↦ cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u) ⁻¹' S)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.measurable_volume_cornerOuterTimes_family
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.support_volume_cornerOuterTimes_subset
statement:
theorem support_volume_cornerOuterTimes_subset {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerReservoir_scalar_bounds
statement:
theorem cornerReservoir_scalar_bounds {I : Set ℝ} (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : κ ∈ cornerReservoir I a b c δ) :
    κ ≠ 0 ∧ δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ^ 2 ≤ |κ| ∧
      |κ| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 3

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.cornerReservoir_spec
statement:
theorem cornerReservoir_spec {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1)
    (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ I) (hb : b ∈ I) (hc : c ∈ I)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    MeasurableSet (cornerReservoir I a b c δ) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 3 / 160000) ≤
        volume (cornerReservoir I a b c δ) ∧
      ∀ κ ∈ cornerReservoir I a b c δ, κ ≠ 0 ∧
        δ * ((volume I).toReal / 100) ^ 2 ≤ |κ| ∧ |κ| ≤ (100 / (volume I).toReal) ^ 3 ∧
        MeasurableSet (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ) ∧ cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ ⊆ I ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 7 / 320000000000) ≤
          volume (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ) ∧
        ∀ u ∈ cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ,
          ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000) ≤
            volume (dualTimes I b a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ u))

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.lintegral_cornerOuterTimes_discarded_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_cornerOuterTimes_discarded_le {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    (∫⁻ κ in (cornerReservoir I a b c δ)ᶜ, volume (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 4 / 160000)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.lintegral_cornerOuterTimes_retained_lower
statement:
theorem lintegral_cornerOuterTimes_retained_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.measurableSet_node_inner_times_family
NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.cornerNodeParameters_child_triple
statement:
theorem cornerNodeParameters_child_triple {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : b ∈ I)
    {p : ℝ × ((Fin D → ℝ) × (Fin L → Fin D → ℝ))}
    (hp : p ∈ S.cornerNodeParameters I a b c δ) (i j : Fin L) :
    ((b, S.time (p.2.2 i) j),
      dualTime b a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c p.1 (S.time p.2.1 i)) (S.time (p.2.2 i) j)) ∈
        separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.cornerNodeParameters_inner_time_mem
statement:
theorem cornerNodeParameters_inner_time_mem {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {p : ℝ × ((Fin D → ℝ) × (Fin L → Fin D → ℝ))}
    (hp : p ∈ S.cornerNodeParameters I a b c δ) (i j : Fin L) :
    S.time (p.2.2 i) j ∈ dualTimes I b a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c p.1 (S.time p.2.1 i))

statement:
theorem cornerNodeParameters_outer_time_mem {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

statement:
theorem volume_cornerNodeParameters_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 1) (hc : c ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hab : δ ≤ dist a b) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (S.lowerConstant *
      (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000) ^ S.volumeExponent) ^ L *
      ENNReal.ofReal (S.lowerConstant *
        (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 7 / 320000000000) ^ S.volumeExponent) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 3 / 160000) ≤
        volume (S.cornerNodeParameters I a b c δ)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.volume_node_inner_parameters_lower
statement:
theorem volume_node_inner_parameters_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ κ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hκ : κ ∈ cornerReservoir I a b c δ) {σ : Fin D → ℝ}
    (hσ : σ ∈ S.select (cornerOuterTimes I a b c δ κ)) (i : Fin L) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (S.lowerConstant * (δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000) ^ S.volumeExponent) ≤
      volume (S.select (dualTimes I b a (cornerInnerCoefficient a c κ (S.time σ i))))

statement:
theorem volume_node_inner_product_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

statement:
theorem volume_node_outer_parameters_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

statement:
theorem volume_node_scalar_fiber_lower {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.exists_node_volume_constant
statement:
theorem exists_node_volume_constant {m D L : ℕ} {β : ℝ}
    (S : SelectableProjectionScheme m β D L) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ I : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet I → I ⊆ Icc 0 1 → 0 < volume I →
      ∀ p ∈ separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100),
        ENNReal.ofReal (C * (volume I).toReal ^ (4 + (8 + 6 * L) * S.volumeExponent)) ≤
          volume (S.cornerNodeParameters I p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 ((volume I).toReal / 100))

statement:
theorem cornerNodeParameters_inner_coordinates_bound {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {p : ℝ × ((Fin D → ℝ) × (Fin L → Fin D → ℝ))}
    (hp : p ∈ S.cornerNodeParameters I a b c δ) (i : Fin L) (j : Fin D) :

      ((δ * (volume I).toReal ^ 5 / 8000000)⁻¹) ^ S.boundExponent

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.cornerNodeParameters_inner_estimate
statement:
theorem cornerNodeParameters_inner_estimate {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    (hIunit : I ⊆ Icc 0 1) (hIpos : 0 < volume I) {a b c δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {p : ℝ × ((Fin D → ℝ) × (Fin L → Fin D → ℝ))}
    (hp : p ∈ S.cornerNodeParameters I a b c δ) (i : Fin L) {G : Set (Line m)}

      (parallelMultiplicity G).toReal ^ (2 - β) *
      (sliceSize (Finset.univ.image (S.time (p.2.2 i))) G).toReal ^ β

theorem cornerNodeParameters_outer_estimate {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.Selection.SelectableProjectionScheme.exists_tree_volume_constant
statement:
theorem exists_tree_volume_constant (J : ℕ) :

      ∀ q ∈ separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100),

    (hq : q ∈ separatedTriples I ((volume I).toReal / 100)) :
    B ^ (L * L) * volume (S.cornerNodeParameters I q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2 ((volume I).toReal / 100)) ≤

statement:
theorem node_inner_uniform_estimate {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I)

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.hasProjectionEstimate_of_normalized
statement:
theorem hasProjectionEstimate_of_normalized [Nonempty (Fin m)] {β C : ℝ}
    {Γ : Finset ℝ} (hΓ : Γ.Nonempty) (hC : 0 < C)
    (hbound : ∀ G : Set (Line m), MeasurableSet G → IsBounded G →
      (parallelMultiplicity G).toReal ≤ 1 →
      ∀ N : ℝ, 1 ≤ N → (∀ t ∈ Γ, volume (atHeight t '' G) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal N) →
      (volume G).toReal ≤ C * N ^ β) : HasProjectionEstimate m β Γ

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.volume_le_of_normalized
statement:
theorem volume_le_of_normalized [Nonempty (Fin m)] {β C : ℝ}
    {Γ : Finset ℝ} (hΓ : Γ.Nonempty) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ G : Set (Line m), MeasurableSet G → IsBounded G →
      (parallelMultiplicity G).toReal ≤ 1 →
      ∀ N : ℝ, 1 ≤ N → (∀ t ∈ Γ, volume (atHeight t '' G) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal N) →
      (volume G).toReal ≤ C * N ^ β)
    {G : Set (Line m)} (hG : MeasurableSet G) (hGb : IsBounded G) :
    (volume G).toReal ≤ C * (parallelMultiplicity G).toReal ^ (2 - β) *
      (sliceSize Γ G).toReal ^ β

    (hu : u ∈ P.outer) (ht : t ∈ P.inner u) :
    r ^ m ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal |(((P.a - P.b) /
      (dualTime P.b P.a (cornerInnerCoefficient P.a P.c P.κ u) t - P.b)) ^ m)⁻¹|).toReal

name: NKBesicovitch.Projection.controlCoefficient_pos
statement:
theorem controlCoefficient_pos (m : ℕ) (β : ℝ) {r C : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hC : 0 < C) :
